description: This is a Java source file defining the OFBizRealm class, which extends RealmBase and provides methods for retrieving user passwords and creating Principals for authentication purposes within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: OFBizRealm
classes.description: A custom Realm implementation for Apache OFBiz that retrieves user credentials and principals from the OFBiz entity engine.

methods.name: getPassword
methods.description: Retrieves the current password for a given username from the UserLogin entity in OFBiz.

methods.name: getPrincipal
methods.description: Creates a Principal object for a given username, associating it with relevant roles.
